powers.title: Icon of Victory
powers.description: The icons of victory were runes that steeled the divine echelons against the primordial hordes. You invoke the least of these runes, inspiring your allies to victory.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. You and your allies gain a +2 power bonus to attack rolls while within the zone.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Mark of Skilled Effort
powers.description: You call on the runes of knowledge to grant to an ally the skill he or she needs to complete a daunting task.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a +5 power bonus to his or her next skill check without proficiency or a +2 power bonus to his or her next skill check with proficiency.

powers.title: Rune of the Final Effort
powers.description: You trace the rune of the final effort on your ally, granting him or her the resilience needed to see the battle to the end.
rows: Target: One bloodied ally
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a +5 power bonus to all defenses.

powers.title: Shield of Sacrifice
powers.description: You invoke the rune of sacrifice, ensuring that he or she who gives strength in the name of the gods will also receive their protection.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst

Effect: The target loses a healing surge. One or two allies within 5 squares of the target regain hit points as if they had each spent a healing surge. The target and each ally who regained hit points gain a +5 power bonus to AC until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Banner of Alliance
powers.description: You invoke the rune of shared pains, allowing you to absorb the punishment meant for an ally.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever the target takes damage, you can use an immediate interrupt to take the damage in the target's place.

powers.title: Compact of Peace
powers.description: You invoke the runes of peace, making a pledge to set aside your weapons and giving you and your allies the chance to negotiate.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains a +5 power bonus to Diplomacy checks and Insight checks until the end of your next turn. The effect ends if any target makes an attack.

powers.title: Rune of Meritorious Alacrity
powers.description: As battle begins, you invoke the rune of meritorious alacrity, bringing your friends instantly to readiness.
rows: Trigger: You roll initiative
Target: You and each ally
Effect: Each target gains a +10 bonus to his or her initiative check.

powers.title: Rune of Unyielding Steel
powers.description: The rune of unyielding steel strengthens anything, even a living creature's skin, to the point that arrows and blades bounce off it.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: The target gains a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn or until he or she is no longer adjacent to you.

powers.title: Words of Compassion
powers.description: You write words that heal your ally with their inner warmth.
rows: Target: You or one ally in the burst
Effect: The target regains hit points equal to his or her healing surge value. In addition, the target gains a +2 power bonus to saving throws until the end of his or her next turn.

powers.title: Banner of Resolution
powers.description: You invoke the rune of resolve, granting your ally the bravery and strength needed to repel the enemy.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target gains 5 temporary hit points whenever he or she hits with an attack.

powers.title: Protective Scroll
powers.description: With masterful precision, you turn a small strip of parchment into a powerful ward.
rows: Effect: You spend a healing surge but regain no hit points. Instead, you create a palm-sized protective scroll that lasts until it is expended or until the end of your next extended rest. A creature carrying the scroll can use a minor action to expend the scroll and regain hit points equal to your healing surge value. The creature also gains a +5 power bonus to all defenses until the end of its next turn.

powers.title: Rune of Daunting Light
powers.description: You invoke a rune on yourself and your allies that makes you all appear daunting even when your defenses are down.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: The targets don't grant combat advantage until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Rune of Shared Lore
powers.description: You invoke the rune of shared lore. Your skill is your allies' skill, and theirs is yours.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Choose a skill. Until the end of the encounter, whenever each target makes a check with that skill, he or she uses the highest bonus for that skill from among all the targets.

powers.title: Rune of the Astral Winds
powers.description: You place a rune of the astral winds on your ally, allowing him or her to slip by your enemies in safety.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: You slide the target 4 squares.
Special: You can use this power only once per round.
